Dream Big. Build Fast

Full-Stack Engineer, Designer Experience

Full-Stack Engineer, Designer Experience

About Moon

Moon’s mission is to reinvent the home improvement experience end to end. From AI-driven marketing and in-home 3D design to sales, service, and operations, Moon unifies the entire customer and business journey on a single platform — supercharged by Luna, our proprietary AI engine. Where most operators stitch together disconnected tools that don't understand the homeowner, we're building the unified operating system the industry has never had. We're a rapidly growing team of committed builders, driven to reimagine how this industry sells, designs, and delivers — and to power the next generation of operators, from single-location dealers to national franchise networks.

Moon is an ambitious company reinventing the home improvement experience. We have the unique opportunity to work with market leading customers such as Closet World, Closets by Design, Closet Dimensions, and Brio Water. We build for the home improvement industry from within it.

Role Overview

You will build the designer's selling tool - .NET services behind a modern TypeScript front-end - on a team where everything you ship gets used by real professionals in real homes within days. This is a role for an engineer early in their career who wants compounding growth: senior engineers to learn from, real ownership from the start, and a product whose impact you can see in the field.

About the role

•   You will join a newly formed team early in its build-out, with an AI-native, continuous-delivery culture and direct access to the users of your work.

What you'll do

•   Build features across the stack: C#/.NET APIs and services, and the modern TypeScript front-end.

•   Ship continuously behind feature flags on the shared design system, meeting the team's quality standards every time.

•   Write automated tests as part of every change - quality here is engineered into the pipeline, not inspected afterward.

•   Work directly with the designers who use the product; turn their feedback into fast, precise iterations.

•   Learn the domain deeply - the workflows of in-home design and selling - because the best engineers here understand the business their code serves.

•   Grow fast: cross-review with senior engineers, increasing scope, and a path to owning features end to end.

Qualifications

•   2+ years of full-stack engineering; C#/.NET exposure preferred, strong web fundamentals required.

•   TypeScript proficiency; mobile or hybrid app exposure a plus.

•   Strong delivery instincts and a record of finishing what you start.

•   Comfortable with AI-assisted development - or eager to become excellent at it.

•   Curious about users and business impact, not just code.

The pay range for this role is:

130,000 - 160,000 USD per year (Moon HQ)
